financials.source: Not verified via web search in this session. Ascension Health (EIN 43-1671412) is the parent entity of one of the largest Catholic nonprofit health systems in the U.S., operating approximately 140 hospitals across 19 states and Washington D.C. Consolidated revenue is estimated in the $28-29B range based on prior public reporting. Ascension reported a consolidated operating loss of approximately $2.66B in FY2023 (ending June 30, 2023). FY2024 showed significant improvement but specifics not verified. ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer filing for EIN 43-1671412 needed for exact 990 figures.

taxAdvantage.notes: Ascension operates approximately 140 hospitals and 40 senior living facilities across 19 states, all property-tax-exempt. Tax-exempt bond interest subsidy applies to estimated $10B+ in outstanding debt. Tennessee has no state income tax on wages. Federal income tax foregone on a system of this scale is substantial. Total tax advantage across the 19-state system not quantified.

legalIssues.description: Major ransomware cyberattack disrupted Ascension operations nationwide, affecting electronic health records, phone systems, and clinical operations across multiple states including Tennessee. Systems were taken offline for weeks. The attack impacted patient care workflows and billing operations across the entire system.

accusation: Ascension holds an estimated $17-20 billion investment portfolio managed by its own investment subsidiary and total assets reported in the $37-41 billion range, yet posted a $2.66 billion operating loss in FY2023, suffered a system-wide ransomware attack in May 2024 that disrupted patient care across 19 states including Nashville, and continues to serve as the Tennessee Titans' official healthcare partner with training facility naming rights -- all while maintaining tax-exempt status on approximately 140 hospitals and 40 senior living facilities.
